tests.scenario: Given the room/door grid, When its last row is read, Then every cell equals rampIndex('lamp',5)
tests.detail: expected +0 to be 47. doorGrid() in src/art/roomFurniture.ts:128-139 draws the lamp-5 strip on rows h-3..h-2 (fillRect(g, 1, h - 3, w - 2, 2, ...)), and the bottom row (h-1) is then the outline from outlineRect(g, 0, 0, w, h, OUTLINE), so it is not lamp 5. Act must move the strip to the bottom row or the spec must be corrected; the assertion was not loosened.
